The text also shares doctrinal formulas with nikāya discourses including the *Sotāpatti Saṁyutta* (SN 55), the *Dasakanipāta* (AN 10), the *Chakkanipāta* (AN 6), and the *Cūḷahatthipadopama Sutta* (MN 27), as well as the Abhidhamma commentary *Pañcapakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus].
